items.label: Small In Size, Big On Function
items.value: Featuring a Fan, Flashlight, and Backup Power Bank, the JISULIFE pocket bear fan is your summer go-to essential for staying cool on hot days while offering versatile functionality to meet your diverse needs

items.label: 12-19 Hours Cooling Time
items.value: With up to 19 hours of cooling time on a single charge, this mini handheld fan ensures you stay refreshed during travel, concerts, and outdoor adventures; Conveniently rechargeable via USB

items.label: A Palm-sized Backup Charger
items.value: Designed with a pocket size, this portable fan easily fits into any bag for on-the-go convenience; Doubling as a backup power bank, it keeps your devices charged when needed, making it your travel and summer essentials

items.label: Also A Flashlight
items.value: Designed with a flashlight function, You may not look for a flashlight first but you will find that this is quite helpful when going out for a walk at night.

items.label: 3-Stage Transformable Fan
items.value: 3-stage transformable design allows for easy storage with hidden blades, making it compact enough to carry in your pocket; Use it as a handheld fan at 180° fold or as a desktop fan at 270° fold for added versatility

items.label: Your Travel Essentials
items.value: 3 IN 1 Mini fan would be a partner for travel; concert; makeup; eyelash; commute; wedding; camping; office; school; It is also a halloween/Thanksgivings/white elephant/ Christmas gifts/stocking stuffer for women; girl; kids; grandma; friends;Valentines day gifts for her, women

items.label: How To Open
items.value: Method 1: small gap between the cover and the fan body for opening. Method 2: press the base where the usb connecters are and the main body on the top is exposed, and the pull it out

items.label: How To Use
items.value: Short press to turn the fan on/off and cycle the fan speed; Long preess to turn the flashlight on/off. Please note that the fan and the flashlight cannot work at the same time.
